settings.title: Settings
settings.defaultModelHint: The model a member uses until it is given one in the conversation. Any enabled provider's model can be the default.

sectionHints.general: Basic preferences such as the interface language.
sectionHints.appearance: Light, dark or following the system, and the interface colors. Members keep their role colors in every theme.
sectionHints.roles: Each role's default avatar. Members without an avatar of their own follow it; click a member's avatar in its conversation to change just that member.
sectionHints.engine: CoBot uses the Codex engine bundled with the ChatGPT desktop app and authorizes its safety hook at startup. Sign in separately in CoBot’s private environment.
sectionHints.models: Used by a member until it is given its own model in the conversation; applies to work that starts afterwards.
sectionHints.providers: Configure once and use it from Codex and Claude Code. Every enabled provider's models can be chosen in the conversation, Another model from a vendor's own provider continues the conversation; another provider, or another model on a gateway, starts a new one that is handed the full record of the old.
sectionHints.collaboration: Team size, how often members may wake each other, and usage budget.
sectionHints.archived: View, restore, or delete archived chats and teams.
